statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; let μ := fun d : ℕ => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ); let U := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/16:ℝ)⌋₊; let B₂ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let B₃ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let τ₃ := fun (n m : ℕ) => ∑ a ∈ (Nat.divisors m).filter (fun a => B₂ n < a ∧ a ≤ B₃ n ∧ U n < m / a), (∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors a).filter (fun d => U n < d), μ d) * Λ (m / a); let Jdeep := fun (n : ℕ) (u v : ℕ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun x => S n u x * S n v x * E (-(n:ℝ)*x)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ n : ℕ, let f := fun t : ℝ => (S n (τ₃ n) t)^2 * E (-(n:ℝ)*t); Jdeep n (τ₃ n) (τ₃ n) = ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), τ₃ n k * τ₃ n (n-k)):ℝ) - intervalIntegral ((wideArcs n).indicator f) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume

brief.zh: 先用整数频率正交求全圆系数。用有限个可测有理弧分去宽弧。保留冻结声明的截断和复数值，供比较 GSP 的中央窗和乘积截断。
brief.en: Use orthogonality of integer frequencies on the full interval. Subtract the finite union of measurable wide arcs. Keep the frozen cutoffs and complex value when comparing with GSP.
